note: What a server sends when a unit comes into what a side can see. It states everything a client needs to draw the unit at once, and carries whole messages of the same family for anything a layout of its own cannot say.

bits.name: size
bits.note: How many bytes the messages below occupy in total. Nothing observed sets the three bits above it, so a plain sixteen bit count reads every payload alike.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. Clear in everything observed.

fields.name: messages
fields.note: Whole messages of the same family, each behind its own length, that a client reads as though they had arrived on their own.

fields.name: itemCount
fields.note: How many items the unit holds.

fields.name: items
fields.note: The items themselves.

fields.name: hasShields
fields.note: One in everything observed. Nothing observed shows what a zero changes, and the three figures below follow either way in every payload seen.

fields.name: magicShield
fields.note: How much of the unit's shielding turns aside one sort of damage.

fields.name: physicalShield
fields.note: How much turns aside the other.

fields.name: shield
fields.note: How much turns aside either.

fields.name: appearanceCount
fields.note: How many layers of look follow.

fields.name: appearance
fields.note: What the unit looks like, laid on in order.

fields.name: lookingAt
fields.note: What the unit is turned towards, or zero where it is turned towards a place instead.

fields.name: lookKind
fields.note: What sort of thing it is turned towards.

fields.name: lookX
fields.note: Which way the unit is turned, along one ground axis. The three together read as a direction rather than a place.

fields.name: lookY
fields.note: Which way it is turned, in height.

fields.name: lookZ
fields.note: Which way it is turned, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: effectStackCount
fields.note: How many effect slots have more than one stacked in them.

fields.name: effectStacks
fields.note: Those slots and their counts.

fields.name: isChampion
fields.note: Whether the unit is a champion.

fields.name: movementKind
fields.note: What the unit is doing on the ground, and so which shape follows. Standing and moving have been observed; nothing observed carries either of the other two, and what follows them is not recorded here.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The name this statement of movement answers to. Its values are observed in the same run as the one WaypointGroup carries.

fields.name: movement
fields.note: Where the unit is going. spec/movement.md says how a path is read.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the unit stands, along one ground axis.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other.

fields.name: facingX
fields.note: Which way it faces, along one ground axis.

fields.name: facingZ
fields.note: Which way it faces, along the other.
